headings.item7: Forged fittings built for reliable connections

copy.item1: HYS Flanges Co. Ltd specializes in producing flanges and fittings for all types of applications. Our products serve a wide range of industries, including oil and gas pipelines, oil refineries, power generation, construction, shipbuilding and offshore engineering, boilers and heat exchangers, machinery, sanitary systems, instrumentation, chemical and petrochemical plants, palm oil processing, biodiesel production, and more.
copy.item2: At HYS Flanges Co. Ltd, our corporate values and commitment to high-quality service, flanges, and fittings guide every business strategy and goal. We continually improve our services and expand our product range to serve our customers more effectively.
copy.item3:
• Maintain ready stock of flanges and fittings to support customers and expand our market reach.
• Broaden our product range to meet customer requirements and support long-term business growth.
• Provide dependable, ongoing support to every customer.
• Deliver excellent after-sales service through our experienced sales team.
copy.item4: HYS Flanges Co. Ltd manufactures high-quality flanges for oil and gas, refining, power generation, shipbuilding, offshore engineering, chemical processing, and other industrial applications. Our flanges are engineered for reliable connections, long service life, and performance across low- and high-pressure systems.
copy.item5: Mill test certification is available upon request.
copy.item6: HYS Flanges Co. Ltd produces forged fittings for industrial piping systems, including threaded and socket-weld configurations. Our fittings are manufactured to recognized standards and supplied in a range of sizes and pressure classes to meet project requirements.

items.title: HYS Flanges
items.description: HYS Flanges Co. Ltd produces flanges for a wide range of industrial piping applications. Mill test certification is available as required.

specifications.label: Standards
specifications.value: JIS B2220, ANSI B16.5, DIN, BS 4504 and BS 10

specifications.label: Types
specifications.value: Plate, blind, slip-on, weld neck, threaded and socket weld

items.title: ASME Orifice Flanges
items.description: Orifice flanges are used with orifice meters to measure the flow of liquids or gases in pipelines. Pressure tapping points are machined into the flange, removing the need for separate tapping in the pipe wall.

items.title: Spectacle Flanges
items.description: A spectacle flange consists of two metal discs connected by a small section of steel. It is used in piping systems that require regular isolation or interruption of flow.

items.title: ANSI Flanges
items.description: Our ANSI flange range includes slip-on, weld neck, lap joint, blind, threaded and socket weld types. Flanges are supplied as forgings unless otherwise specified.

items.title: Reducing Flanges & Long Weld Neck Flanges
items.description: Reducing flanges connect pipes of different sizes, with weld neck, slip-on and threaded options. Long weld neck flanges provide an extended connection, with special bores and custom variations available on request.

headings.item4:
BRAND: HYS FLANGES
Our flanges are available with mill test certification upon request.
headings.item5:
Our flange range includes:
1. JIS B2220 FLANGE – 5K, 10K, 16K, 20K, 30K, 40K, TYPES OF PLFF, PLRF, BLIND, HUB ETC.
2. ANSI B16.5 FLANGE – 150LB, 300LB, 600LB, TYPES OF PLFF, PLRF, BLIND, SORF, WNRF, NPT ETC.
3. DIN FLANGE – PN6, PN10, PN16, PN25, PN40, PN64, TYPES OF PLFF, PLRF, BLIND, WNRF ETC.
4. BS 4504 FLANGE – PN6, PN10, PN16, PLFF, PLRF, TYPES OF PLRF, BLIND, SORF, WNRF, BSPT ETC.
5. BS 10 FLANGE – TABLE D, TABLE E, TABLE F ETC.
headings.item8: Orifice flanges are used with orifice meters to measure the flow of liquids or gases in pipelines. Pressure tapping points are machined into the flange, eliminating the need for separate tapping in the pipe wall.
headings.item11:
Class 150 to Class 2500 Spectacle Flanges
A spectacle flange consists of two metal discs connected by a small section of steel. It is used in piping systems that require regular isolation or interruption of flow.
headings.item14: HYS Flanges Co. Ltd offers ANSI flanges in pressure classes from Class 150 to Class 2500.
headings.item15: The ANSI flange specifications cover slip-on, weld neck, lap joint, blind, threaded and socket weld flanges. These flanges are supplied as forgings unless otherwise specified.
headings.item16: Reducing Flanges & Long Weld Neck Flanges
headings.item18: Reducing flanges connect pipes of different sizes. Available types include weld neck, slip-on and threaded reducing flanges, providing an economical transition between pipe sizes.
headings.item19: Long weld neck flanges provide an extended connection where additional length is required. Standard lengths, special bores, contoured bases and other custom variations are available on request.
headings.item23: HYS Flanges Co. Ltd offers flanges in pressure ratings of 5K, 10K, 16K, 20K and 30K.
